companyDescription: Space launch + systems company · Electron small rocket (proven, 50+ missions) + Neutron medium-lift in development · 'The clear #2 to SpaceX'
priceNote: Stale price as of Jun 18 close — down ~30% from $151 ATH due to SpaceX IPO 'capital siphon' effect. KeyBanc upgraded to Buy ($135 PT) citing selloff as unwarranted.
summary: Rocket Lab is the 'clear #2 to SpaceX' per KeyBanc, offering the only end-to-end space company outside SpaceX with both launch services (Electron) and spacecraft systems. Down 30% from ATH due to SpaceX IPO capital rotation — this is the buying opportunity. Neutron maiden flight is the binary catalyst with 30-50% upside asymmetry. Q2 earnings Aug 6 and potential Nasdaq-100 inclusion are near-term catalysts.

catalysts.name: Neutron Maiden Flight
catalysts.description: Neutron medium-lift rocket (8-ton LEO capacity) maiden flight expected H2 2026. Successful launch would unlock large-class government + commercial contracts and validate RKLB as SpaceX competitor. Binary catalyst — binary outcome.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Earnings Aug 6, 2026. Revenue TTM $679M (+45.8%). Market looking for Electron launch cadence and Neutron timeline update. Strong guidance = sentiment shift.

catalysts.name: Nasdaq-100 Inclusion
catalysts.description: Cantor Fitzgerald analyst says Nasdaq-100 inclusion is 'next big catalyst' — triggered +7% move in June. Inclusion would force index funds to buy and reduce volatility premium.

risks: Neutron maiden flight failure would cause -30-50% immediate selloff — binary event risk
SpaceX IPO (SPCX) siphons institutional capital and mindshare from RKLB — direct competition pressure
Analyst consensus PT $106.92 = barely above current price; upside dependent on Neutron success
Still unprofitable: Net income -$182M TTM; cash burn risk if Neutron delays extend into 2027
Executive insider selling: SVP offloaded $9.5M in shares Jun 18 — worth monitoring

estimateDates.note: Binary catalyst — most important event for the thesis

macroRisk.rateOutlook: FOMC July 29 rate decision. Space/aerospace sector is less directly rate-sensitive than tech, but RKLB's high beta (2.50) means it moves hard on risk-off days. A hike could cause -15-20% from current levels.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Government space contracts (NASA, DoD) are multi-year and inflation-adjusted — provides revenue floor. Commercial launch business is more cyclically sensitive.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM. The SpaceX IPO effect is sector-specific and separate from macro. Fed risk adds volatility but doesn't change the launch contract fundamentals.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — RKLB's government contract revenue provides stability, but high beta (2.5x) and unprofitability mean macro risk-off events hit hard. The Neutron binary event dwarfs macro as the risk factor. Wait for early August entry if possible.

entryStrategy.verdict: Speculative BUY on SpaceX IPO selloff dip — Neutron is the binary bet. Small size now, larger at $92-98 post-FOMC.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Space launch companies historically run 15-30% in weeks before maiden flight announcements. RKLB itself ran +80% in the 6 weeks before SpaceX IPO (sector euphoria), showing how launch milestones trigger massive moves.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 4-6 สัปดาห์ก่อน Neutron flight announcement

postWin.note: RKLB Electron first commercial success (Jan 2018) re-rated company 3x over 18 months. Comparable: Rocket One (RKTO) IPO catalyst +45% in 2 weeks Jun 2026 after successful launch. Space launch first-success events historically deliver 30-60% moves.

postLose.note: Blue Origin New Glenn first anomaly (2025) caused -32% in sector peers. Virgin Orbit failure (Jan 2023) caused RKLB to drop -25% in sympathy despite being unrelated. Neutron failure would be RKLB-specific and potentially -40-50%.

spotSizing.reason: Binary catalyst = size small. 4% of portfolio max. If Neutron succeeds, scale to 10-12% on confirmation. Don't bet farm on binary event.

comparableCases.note: First successful commercial Electron launch validated the company and triggered a 3x re-rate over 18 months. Neutron success would be an even larger inflection point given the medium-lift market size.

comparableCases.event: Rocket One Successful Launch + SpaceX IPO euphoria
comparableCases.note: Competitor Rocket One surged 45% in 2 weeks after successful launch during SpaceX IPO enthusiasm. Shows the sector re-rates hard on successful new rocket milestones.
Blue Origin anomaly caused -30% across space stocks in sympathy. A Neutron failure would be worse for RKLB (direct, not sympathy). Underscores binary nature of launch catalyst.
